rows.label: tickRise: the shaft-hit tap, once per shaft hit healed, after its blessing, carrying the count
rows.code:
T.bless += u.healPer * n;
          /* ASCENSION'S SHAFT HIT (v74 §6.2: "a bright glassy tap, 70ms,
             quiet; blessing count in the pitch"): once per shaft hit healed,
             after its blessing lands -- the NEXT live step after the blow,
             once the blow's own hit stop has run -- pitched by the count the
             caster now carries (1-5; at the cap the blessing refreshes and it
             taps at 5's note). The blow keeps its own `hit` voice. A shaft
             hit on a Twinshade shade heals too, so it taps too. Presentation
             only: SFX.play draws nothing, is a no-op headless, and nothing
             here is read back (angelus_voice_lab: fights identical). */
          SFX.play("ult", { w: "angelus-shaft", n: f.stacks("blessing") });
rows.why: The tap, at the heal's own step, after the blessing lands: 3555 taps == 3555 shaft hits healed over 152 fights, each carrying the caster's blessing count after the heal (1..5). Fights identical 152/152 and every other voice call identical 152/152 with the rows applied; the rows plus one sim write come back identical in only 1/152.

rows.label: tickRise: the close, when the window closes by its clock with both alive; the drop is marked

READINGS DECLARED (Code's picks under "you pick i overrule"; all are in the lab docstring):
- The chord is D4-A4-D5, the score's iv: root, just fifth and octave.
- The close resolves each voice down a fourth to A3-E4-A4, the tonic (a plagal "Amen" cadence).
- "Re-struck" means in phase at whole cycles, every ~11 ms, with `.frequency.value = f` set on every strike.
- The swell crests at the arrival (0.43 s = the 0.08 s hit stop + the 0.35 s rise). "0.6s" is the whole voice.
- The tap's pitch is one A-minor-pentatonic step per blessing count, using the caster's count after the heal (1-5; at the cap it stays on 5).
- The tap plays on the heal's step, ~67 ms after the blow, once per shaft hit healed. Shade hits count too (reading 11). The hits delta was 1 on every heal.
- The close plays only on a clock close with both fighters alive. It never plays on a death close or at `over`.
- NEW STAGE-6 REQUIREMENT (reading 10, the window still open at the kill in 57% of fights): step() returns before any ticker, so no tap, close or thud can sound after the end. The kill's own voices have that moment and the picture closes the shafts. Measured: 86 of 606 windows are open at the end, 0 clock closes fall on the step the foe died (foe.alive is the hp>0 getter, so a smite-DoT kill that step is excluded), and 8 windows close on a death.
- The landing thud is NEW because the engine had none; the wall tick still plays under it. It sounds on the first floor contact after a clock close, with the caster alive, using `riseTally.falling`. riseTally is the probe's tally and the sim never reads it; fights stay identical with it.
- Edge case, not measured: a thud can share a step with a foe killed earlier in that step (Angelus on side B, the foe dying of its own status tick). The ball did land, so I left it.
